short: Size and congruence conditions for the two auxiliary primes

lean.name: UpperTheory.Top.WinPair
lean.plain: Size and congruence conditions for the two auxiliary primes
lean.note: The auxiliary primes are chosen on the scale of the window parameter $Y$, so their size conditions stay fixed throughout the window. Besides the two logarithmic size bounds, the definition requires $d+1$ to be divisible by $q$ and all odd primes up to $Y^{\varepsilon/5}$.
